says: The P42 start_child laws on real runners, run from next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/StartChild.test.ts, each take tens of seconds to minutes on one CI shard, so the shard sits close to its limits.
proof: CI run 43553536844, attempt 1, job 132321971161 (pull request 1146 at c6e94784c), verbose reporter: L5 102198 ms, L6 86137 ms, L7 45790 ms, and the three L7 exit-order cases 13544, 12664 and 15186 ms, all passing. The lead read 244 s and 50 s for L6 in another job of the same run.
cost: One shard carries several minutes of a single file, so any slice that adds work to a start turns that shard red on time, not on a broken law, and every pull request that touches next/ waits on it.
